review_scope: Three agents cross-reviewed the ordinary arguments and replayed exact controls. The first-hit bound, unsigned decoding, odd-pivot identities, 144-bit state continuation, both crossing cuts, and widened pressure-gain interval received independent review. These checks are not a new Lean proof or a proof of uniform norm-selection complexity.
verification_coverage: The full 195-recipe baseline suite passed at the recorded baseline. The 30 additional default recipes at d42e464 were run separately, covering that 225-recipe checkpoint. The final 42-command research suite passed against the source hashes here. This does not claim that every later concurrent main-branch addition was included in the earlier baseline or incremental suites.

adaptive_144_bit.scope: Repeats all rejected and accepted candidates in both phases.

adaptive_144_bit_default.scope: Verifies accepted first-phase witnesses and reruns the continuation; does not repeat rejected first-phase candidates.

independent_adaptive_review.scope: Differential comparison of resumed schedules and fresh wider-window runs; also independently replayed the 154884-candidate continuation.

final_proof_refinements.adaptive_candidate_bound: At most sum_p w_p <= m W_* candidate tests using retained first hits. Doubling requires at most 1+ceil(log_2 W_*) phases; setup and state validation are charged separately.
final_proof_refinements.eight_letter_crossing: Characteristic two, actual degree 32, rational-type rate rho<18/25. Strict pressure gain over the matched coordinate control for every finite s>=10/9. The certified trial value 18/25 remains above 1/sqrt(2); no lower bound on the unknown optimized rate is asserted.
final_proof_refinements.dynamic_norm_calls: 2208 leading-norm factorization calls on 2201 distinct integers of at most 30 bits in the 60-bit control; this is not a count of internal helper certification calls.
